title: Uniform convergence to an irrationally indifferent fixed point
exact_target: Can an irrationally indifferent holomorphic germ have iterates converging uniformly to its fixed point on a domain? Also consider germs extending to entire functions and algebraic germs.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300068 (AMR-052-0068). CC BY 4.0.

Ben Bielefeld, Mikhail Lyubich and contributors, \emph{Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics}, arXiv:math/9205209v1 (1992), Alexandre Eremenko and Mikhail Lyubich, ``Wandering Domains for Holomorphic Maps, Question 2 and following paragraph.
